GM G+ iSmart Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charger – Smart Power for All Your Apple Devices

The GM G+ iSmart Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charger Magnetic, Automatic Rotation, 15W Fast Charging with Super Magnet is designed to redefine everyday charging with innovation, speed, and elegance. Built for modern Apple users, this advanced charging station supports Qi2 compatible devices, including iPhone, Apple Watch, and wireless earbuds, all in one compact and intelligent design.

Featuring a powerful Qi2-certified magnetic wireless charging system, the GM G+ iSmart charger ensures perfect alignment every time. The strong super magnet securely holds your iPhone in place, enabling 15W fast wireless charging with improved efficiency and reduced energy loss. Whether you are charging overnight or powering up during work hours, this charger delivers consistent and safe performance.

Automatic Rotation with 180° Touch Control

One of the standout features of the GM G+ iSmart Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charger is its automatic rotation with 180° touch rotation. With a simple touch, the charging pad smoothly rotates to your preferred viewing angle. This makes it ideal for FaceTime calls, video streaming, StandBy mode, or hands-free navigation while charging your phone.

The intelligent rotation mechanism adds both convenience and a premium feel, transforming your charging station into a smart desktop accessory. Whether placed on a bedside table or office desk, it blends functionality with modern aesthetics.

Pop-up Design with 3-in-1 Charging Convenience

The smart pop-up design allows you to charge three devices simultaneously without clutter. The dedicated charging zones are precisely engineered for:

  • iPhone with Qi2 magnetic wireless charging (up to 15W fast charging)
  • Apple Watch with stable and safe charging output
  • Wireless earbuds including AirPods and other Qi-compatible earphones

This 3-in-1 wireless charger for iPhone Apple Watch and earbuds eliminates the need for multiple cables, making it perfect for travel, home, or office use. Simply place your devices and let the charger handle the rest.

Super Magnet & Advanced Safety Protection

Equipped with a super strong magnetic alignment system, the charger ensures your device stays firmly connected even during rotation. The enhanced magnetic grip improves charging stability while protecting your device from accidental slips. The GM G+ iSmart Qi2 charger also includes advanced safety features such as over-voltage protection, temperature control, short-circuit prevention, and foreign object detection. This guarantees safe charging for all your Qi2 compatible devices, extending battery life and device durability.

Premium Design for Modern Spaces

Designed with a sleek, minimal, and premium finish, this magnetic wireless charger complements any modern setup. Its compact footprint saves space while the elegant pop-up structure adds a futuristic touch to your desk or bedside table. Whether you are a tech enthusiast or a professional looking for a reliable charging solution, the GM G+ iSmart Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charger offers the perfect balance of innovation, speed, and style.

Key Features at a Glance

  • Qi2-certified 3-in-1 wireless charger for iPhone, Apple Watch, and earbuds
  • 15W fast wireless charging with super strong magnetic alignment
  • Automatic rotation with 180° touch rotation control
  • Smart pop-up design for clutter-free charging
  • Compatible with Qi2-enabled iPhones, Apple Watch, and wireless earbuds
  • Advanced safety protection for secure and efficient charging

Upgrade your charging experience with the and enjoy faster, smarter, and more organized power delivery for all your essential devices.
